## Activity

During June 2025, Central Eye Clinic recorded 224 captures as part of its routine activity. This figure represents the total number of images captured at the site during the month. The activity should continue to be monitored through the usual local reporting arrangements, with any operational issues recorded for follow-up where required.

## Image quality

Image quality was generally suitable for grading. A total of 4 captures were ungradable, giving an ungradable rate of 1.8. The clinic should continue to review image quality at the point of capture and ensure that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. This will support identification of equipment or process issues that may affect future activity.

## Grading

There were 69 referable results during June 2025. The median grading lag was 3. This provides the current measure of turnaround for the month and should be considered alongside activity and image-quality results in routine review. Continued monitoring will help Central Eye Clinic identify any changes in grading demand, image quality, or processing performance.
